title: Essex County corrections officer charged with smuggling drugs, cellphone to inmate
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Crime The officer allegedly brought sheets of paper soaked with drugs into the House of Correction and delivered them to an inmate.

By Darin Zullo September 20, 2026 | 10:17 AM 1 minute to read An Essex County corrections officer is facing conspiracy charges for allegedly smuggling a cellphone and cannabinoid-soaked sheets of paper to an inmate at the Middleton House of Correction, records show.

Christal Dunston, 33, of Lynn, was arraigned Thursday on charges of conspiracy to violate drug law, two counts of delivering drugs or articles to a prisoner, and possessing drugs or articles with intent to deliver to a prisoner, the Essex County District Attorney’s Office said in a press release.
